thread:
Alex Chen: quick Q from all-hands — when will promotions be finalized for Q2? I heard something about a two-step comp calibration, timeline?
Priya Kapoor: Thanks Alex! Final calibration meeting is 2026-04-10. Managers will get final letters by 2026-04-12, pay changes effective 2026-04-28 payroll. We do a calibration + comp admin step.
Jordan Lee: For leveling: if someone is transitioning to an EM role, do we wait until they've been in role X months? Any fast-tracking?
Priya Kapoor: We can fast-track case-by-case with manager+director signoff. Criteria: demonstrated ownership, team size, scope. Submit case via the leveling form (link). Expect 2-3 week turnaround for fast-track.
Sam Rivera: Are retroactive increases possible if a promotion was delayed?
Priya Kapoor: We try to avoid retroactive comp, but if there's an admin delay we sometimes backdate to promotion effective date — needs payroll approval. Send me details offline.
Irene Gomez: Benefits timing — open enrollment window mentioned in all-hands? Deadline?
Priya Kapoor: Open enrollment opens 2026-05-01 and closes 2026-05-14. Monthly benefits changes take effect 2026-06-01.
Alex Chen: Thanks! Also curious about leveling calibration: will there be rubrics made public?
Priya Kapoor: Yes — we'll publish a leveling rubric + examples in Notion by 2026-03-30. It's a guideline, not a checklist.
peopleops-bot: Shared doc: <https://redwood-inference.notion.site/leveling-rubric-xyz> :link:
Jordan Lee: Cool. One last — salary bands changes? Any movement this cycle?
Priya Kapoor: We adjusted bands modestly for cost-of-living in target markets. No structural band rename. Managers will see new target comp ranges in the manager packet.
Sam Rivera: ty. Will there be manager calibration workshops?
Priya Kapoor: Yes — mandatory calibration training for managers on 2026-04-06 10:00 PT. Calendar invites going out.
Alex Chen: @Priya can you add example phrasing for promotion conversations?
Priya Kapoor: Yep — will add sample scripts to the manager packet and the public rubric.
Jordan Lee: :thumbsup:
Irene Gomez: :wave: marked calendar.
Priya Kapoor: If folks want 1:1 clarifications, office hours next week Thu 9-11 PT. Sign up sheet in the doc.
Alex Chen: Great — appreciate it!
